profile.headline: Founder and Software Engineer at Code Slate LLC
profile.summary:
Principal-level software engineer specializing in large-scale distributed systems and cloud infrastructure, with a growing focus on AI/ML infrastructure and intelligent operations.
 
Most recently at Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), I was responsible for the Python-based workflow orchestration engine driving rack lifecycle management across 300+ global data centers - orchestrating the full journey from order to revenue-generating capacity, including GPU sleds for AI workloads. The platform handled 28,000+ concurrent workflows at any given time, with zero tolerance for downtime. I also contributed to integrating AI agents for operational support and LLM-assisted development tooling.
 
Previously at Microsoft, I shipped foundational Windows tools (msinfo32.exe, msconfig.exe) used by hundreds of millions of people, and built high-availability infrastructure for Windows Update data centers. I also founded Red Spot Studios, led product development at ORCA Medical Systems, and began my career as a software engineer at Pacific Avionics.
 
Looking for principal engineer opportunities in AI infrastructure, workflow orchestration, platform engineering, and distributed systems where operational scale and reliability are non-negotiable.

Outside of work: guitarist in a band, photographer, and traveler.
 
Stack: Python · Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) · Docker · Distributed Systems · Workflow Orchestration · Rack Lifecycle Management · Terraform · REST APIs · C# · Database Design & Development

positions.title: Founder and Software Engineer
positions.description:
Code Slate is an independent software studio building iPhone apps and web tools, from idea to release. Each project starts with a written technical plan and is built with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, then tested by hand on real devices and real data. The studio draws on a career of shipping production software, from Windows system tools to Oracle Cloud’s data center orchestration engine.

Open to full-time roles or client projects: iPhone apps, web apps, and tools built on existing APIs. Message me here on LinkedIn.

positions.title: Principal Member Of Technical Staff
positions.description:
Built and maintained the workflow orchestration engine at the heart of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure's rack lifecycle management system - the system that turns an order into revenue-generating capacity.
Our distributed, Python-based platform managed every stage of rack deployment across 300+ data centers worldwide: from initial order through delivery, installation, provisioning, and customer onboarding - including GPU sled configurations destined for AI workloads. Decommission workflows handled rack retirement and reuse, including certified data wipe of all storage devices. At peak, 28,000+ concurrent workflows were in flight, with individual deployments running for months or more.
When our systems were healthy, OCI grew. When they weren't, data center construction stopped. That operational reality shaped how I thought about reliability, observability, and incident response - and made on-call support for urgent issues across a global footprint a regular part of the job. Our team was actively integrating AI agents to assist with on-call triage and resolution, and adopting LLM-assisted code generation to accelerate development.
Stack: Python · Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) · Docker · Distributed Systems · Workflow Orchestration · Rack Lifecycle Management · REST APIs · Database Design & Development
positions.insights: Workflow Orchestration, AI Infrastructure and +23 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and developed service code for the Windows Update infrastructure - one of Microsoft's most critical high-availability distributed systems, responsible for delivering security patches to hundreds of millions of Windows devices globally. Downtime meant security vulnerabilities going unpatched worldwide.

Stack: Azure · C# · C++ · SQL Server · HTML · JavaScript

projects.title: 1. OCI Workflow Orchestration Engine
projects.description:
Built and maintained the workflow orchestration engine driving rack lifecycle management across Oracle Cloud Infrastructure's global data center fleet. The system tracked every rack from initial order through delivery, installation, provisioning, and customer onboarding - including GPU sled configurations destined for AI workloads - across 300+ data centers worldwide.

At peak, 28,000+ concurrent long-running workflows were in flight, with individual deployments spanning months. Decommission workflows managed rack retirement and reuse, including certified data wipe of all data-bearing devices. System availability directly gated OCI's capacity growth - when it was down, data center construction stopped.

Stack: Python · Docker · Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) · Distributed Systems · Workflow Orchestration · Rack Lifecycle Management · REST APIs

projects.title: 2. Playlist Repair
projects.description:
Designed and built a browser-only web app that repairs Spotify playlists: it finds greyed-out tracks, matches each to a playable version of the same recording, and swaps the matches in after the user approves them. Built with Claude Code from a written technical plan, one milestone at a time, with every step that writes to a real playlist tested by hand.

The matching engine tries the recording’s ISRC first, then scores title, artist, duration and album into confidence tiers, so whole groups of matches can be approved at once. Repairs are applied safely: backup first, inserts before removals, a verifying rescan, and resume after any error. Developed and tested against a real library of 120 playlists and 14,000+ tracks, within Spotify’s 2026 developer-mode limits, with no backend: OAuth with PKCE, a strict Content Security Policy, and only two network hosts.

Stack: TypeScript · React · Vite · Spotify Web API · OAuth 2.0 (PKCE) · Vitest · Playwright · GitHub Actions · Claude Code
